title: wedelia cardenasii
intro: Wedelia cardenasii, commonly known as Mexican dandelion, is a flowering plant species native to Mexico and Central America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Wedelia cardenasii include expectorant, antiseptic, and anti-inflammatory actions, making it a potential treatment for respiratory infections and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
